'''June 2000 Nashville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Collector's World, Nashville, TN on 14 June 2000. [[Russell Cleeton]] won it. It is known from Josh Koziura's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d896">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-15-nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourneyd896/ nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourney], DeckTech (Josh "Blue1138" Koziura, 15 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-15-nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourneyd896/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Collector's World, Nashville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Russell Cleeton]]
